tdr.scope:
PD46 USB HS TDR check (USB 2.0 sec 7.1.6.2): differential TDR, 400 ps 10-90 incident step, odd mode = per-leg
45 ohm single-ended. Chain from the device connector: connector L/C, COB trace 15 mm (45 ohm, eps 4.8), via/land/finger
L/C, bond L, pad C || termination R. Limits: ZHSTHRU 70..110 ohm (diff) from -500 ps before the connector reference
to the termination measurement time, single excursion beyond limits <= 800 ps (2 x 400 ps) inside a 1.4 ns window;
ZHSTERM 80..100 ohm at 4 ns (B) / 8 ns (A) after the connector reference. Times as displayed (round trip).

usb_hs_term_fs.scope:
USB behaviour of the wirepad attachment with the stress-safe protection drawn in.

Model: the regenerated wired RX/USB layout (drop-in network with discharge, ATB
tap and v2 shunt; Magic device-level extraction, floating conductors anchored as
in the canonical screens). Controls are the attachment's active-high pad ports
driven directly (the receive_control_guard would produce the same levels).
Cases:
  fs   FS J then K at 60 ns: per leg 15 kohm host pull-down and 50 pF; VOH/VOL
       and 10-90 % edge times (USB 2.0 FS: VOH >= 2.8 V, VOL <= 0.3 V, 4-20 ns)
  ls   same drivers into 450 pF (LS needs 75-300 ns; no slew control exists)
  ls_slow  (PD28, opt-in --ls-slow) the ls case with LS_SLOW high (wirepad LS slow-edge mode)
  hs   HS_P switch with HS_PBIAS = VDD - 3.11 V (lifecycle bias) into a far-end
       45 ohm to ground, with and without the on-chip termination; reports the
       delivered current against 17.78 mA (17.78 mA x 22.5 ohm = 400 mV)
  handoff  PULLUP_P on, then at 40 ns pull-up off and termination on (2 ns
       break-before-make); host 15 kohm pull-down
  cap  all controls off, VDD 3.3 V: small-signal capacitance at 1 GHz on PAD_P
       with PAD_N AC-grounded, against the 2.7 pF wired allocation
The HS current source is the attachment's own PMOS (HS_PBIAS); the wired_tx
current cells are not part of this layout. Diagnostics, not USB compliance.

padc_budget.source: USB 2.0 sec 7.1.6.2 lumped guideline: die <= 5.0 pF/line, P/N match <= 1.0 pF, differential <= 5.0 pF; CHSLOAD <= 10 pF incl. package; TDR 70-110 ohm through (passes to >= 10 pF, not binding)
padc_budget.pessimistic: measured x 1.15 wiring + 20 fF ATB leaves

term_calibration_pd43_rerun.scope:
PD43 firmware term-trim calibration evaluation over the extracted cal sweeps (cal-raw.json term R, cal-raw_half.json
half-current observations). Firmware: usbhs.config.current_code at half scale (I_cal nominal 8.89 mA), TERM_ENABLE +
code k, HS_P on, BYPASS on, read V(RX_P) on the ATB leaf -> ATB pad -> board ADC, minus the HS-off reading (offset
cancel); R_meas = dV / 8.89 mA; choose k minimising |R_meas - 45|. Errors (pessimistic, design-assumptions):
HS reference current +-5 % (h 0.475..0.525), ATB/ADC gain +-1 %, residual offset +-2 mV.
